name: Quake II
desc:
Quake II is a famous 1997 first-person shooter that introduced players to a completely new fantasy world.
Near future. The Earth was attacked by the cyborg race of the Strogg, during which several of the largest cities of earthlings were destroyed. Humans organize a counterattack on the Strogg homeworld of Stroggos in order to close the portal through which the invaders are transferring their troops to Earth. The attack quickly collapsed due to the Strogg's effective air defense system, and most of the landing force was captured or destroyed.
The main character, a paratrooper named Bitterman, finds himself at an incorrect landing point due to the fact that during the landing his launch capsule collided with another and deviated from the intended trajectory. Having landed in a remote Strogg base, Bitterman seizes a communications center and receives from the command the task of destroying infrastructure facilities: an air defense system, a plant for the production of new soldiers, an energy reactor. The final task is to destroy the communications system and the Strogg leader Macron himself, hiding on an orbital platform above the planet.
After defeating Macron, Bitterman leaves the collapsing platform in an escape pod. Having made a hard landing on Stroggos, the paratrooper survives, but the further fate of the main character is unknown. In Quake 4, it is mentioned that Bitterman's actions in destroying the air defense system made it possible for the earthlings to carry out a more successful second attack on the planet.

name: Quake II: Mission Pack I - Ground Zero
desc: Second official addition. Ground Zero takes place parallel to Quake II itself. The ground landing began. The Stroggos have activated the Gravity Well, which, like a trap, does not allow the Earth's fleet to leave the orbit of Stroggos. Meanwhile, the Strogg themselves are firing with all their might from a big cannon (the same one that needs to be blown up in Quake II). The player's main task is to destroy the gravity well.

name: Quake II: Mission Pack II - The Reckoning
desc: First official addition. The story begins with you, as a member of an elite unit, must infiltrate an enemy Strogg base. You will explore industrial landscapes, move through water and air, make your way through canyons infested with evil mutants, hide from an alien ship and much more. Your main goal is to destroy the secret enemy base.

name: Quake II: Zaero
desc:
Not an official addition. In spirit, it is somewhat different from the others - the focus is on solving simple “riddles” and finding a large number of objects, which is reminiscent of Hexen II.
As in other add-ons, some of the monsters were “left”, some were “removed” and, naturally, new ones appeared. Among them are bulldogs that can kill with two bites, huge guys with infrared lasers and machine guns, and others. The most distinctive feature is that the boss in the game does not look like Macron at all, it is an absolutely independent creation.
The good news is that there are a significant number of new items and weapons - now you can “rub” a monster with explosives, force even identical species to fight each other using “white light”, kill enemies from a distance using a sniper rifle, deprive monsters of the ability to use weapons and even... kill yourself. The equipment is supplemented with a lot of items - the most interesting is the “visor”, with which you can view those places in the level where you have not yet been.
In general, the game is distinguished by a fairly high complexity (although it is much simpler than the subsequent Ground Zero) and interesting, somewhat unusual gameplay.
